title: BLE packet loss and the 500 ms failsafe
description: Wall 1.2 m ahead. Every packet is dropped from 2.0 to 3.2 s, beginning after a presence-tap neutral packet at 1.95 s. The controller must keep that neutral command, never infer a tap and resurrect stale bands; the 500 ms watchdog then expires. Fresh packets restore the wall. From 4 to 6 s, fixed-seed 30% loss exercises recovery.

expect.label: last neutral held, then watchdog expires
